proyectos.titulo: Complete Overhaul of Stationary Internal Combustion Engine
proyectos.descripcion: Disassembly, dimensional metrology diagnosis, and complete rebuild of the engine block and injection system for a backup power generator. Optimized compression ratios and reduced oil consumption by 14%.

proyectos.titulo: Synchronization and Rewinding of 3-Phase Induction Motors
proyectos.descripcion: Corrective intervention on high-power motors for manufacturing extruders. Included rewinding calculations, Class H insulation setup, dynamic rotor balancing, and Megger insulation testing for safe commissioning.

proyectos.titulo: Structural Upgrades and Fluid Network Deployment in Production Plant
proyectos.descripcion: Field execution supervision for heavy support mounting and routing of compressed air and high-pressure hydraulic pipe networks. Application of industrial epoxy coatings and strict HSEQ compliance.

proyectos.titulo: Laser Alignment and Installation of Machine Beds and Gearboxes
proyectos.descripcion: Rigging and deployment of critical powertrain assemblies. Correction of angular and parallel misalignment using advanced laser instrumentation to eliminate mechanical vibrations and mitigate bearing failures.

proyectos.titulo: Automation and Troubleshooting of Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS)
proyectos.descripcion: Diagnostics and replacement of heavy-duty power contactors and control relays in ATS equipment. Maintained full network failure simulations to guarantee uninterruptible power supply continuity.

proyectos.titulo: Industrial HVAC and Climate Control System Overhaul
proyectos.descripcion: Comprehensive preventive maintenance on Air Handling Units (AHU) and water chillers. Executed HEPA filter updates, chemical cleaning of evaporator coils, and calibration of industrial thermostats.
